name: rylydou-profile
description: Serves the images on my GitHub profile README

scripts.deploy: . ./.env && rsync -rlptz --delete --exclude-from=.dockerignore ./ "${DEPLOY_HOST:?set DEPLOY_HOST in .env}:${DEPLOY_DIR:?set DEPLOY_DIR in .env}/app/" && ssh "$DEPLOY_HOST" "cd '$DEPLOY_DIR' && docker compose up -d --build"
scripts.logs: . ./.env && ssh "${DEPLOY_HOST:?set DEPLOY_HOST in .env}" docker logs -f --tail=100 profile
